**Worst-case TDCG for tomorrow (2024-01-19): ~34,689 ppm** — far above the 4,630 ppm Condition 4 threshold (Condition 1 ≤ 720, Condition 2 721–1920, Condition 3 1921–4630, Condition 4 > 4630).
